name: man-db
description: Implementation of the man command with an on-disk database (whatis/apropos) for fast manual page lookup; provides man, mandb, manpath, whatis, and apropos.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
